tido-utokat-kontaktforbud::sfs-2025-561.label: partial
tido-utokat-kontaktforbud::sfs-2025-561.reason: The law covers larger areas, house searches for service and bans to protect witnesses and complainants in legal proceedings. It adds no rule that specifically gives more bans with electronic monitoring ahead of trials (monitoring was already in the act), so partial is kept, but the judge's note about a truncated pledge quote is not a finding about the law.
tido-utokat-kontaktforbud::sfs-2025-561.missing_sv: Lagen innehåller ingen ny bestämmelse som särskilt ger fler kontaktförbud med elektronisk övervakning inför rättegångar. Skydd för målsägande och vittnen i rättsprocesser läggs dock till.

tido-anonyma-vittnen::sfs-2024-1180.label: full
tido-anonyma-vittnen::sfs-2024-1180.reason: The v6 judge says the act is itself the new system for anonymous witnesses and only rates it medium because the description also mentions an inquiry task. Read in the proposition (Prop. 2024/25:20, section 2.1): court permission to hear a witness anonymously, conditions, public counsel. The promise only commits to introducing the system, and the law has been in force since 2025-01-01.

tido-forlangd-karensperiod-ny-asylansoka.label: none
tido-forlangd-karensperiod-ny-asylansoka.reason: The judge called it partial at low confidence by inference only; SFS 2025:225 extends how long a removal decision applies and the re-entry ban, and its own note finds no extension of the waiting time before a new asylum application, which is what the promise asks for.

tido-utokad-timplan-svenska-matematik::s.label: none
tido-utokad-timplan-svenska-matematik::s.reason: The judge called it partial, but the law (a ten-year compulsory school) does not expand the timetable with a focus on Swedish and mathematics, which is what the promise asks for; the expansion for those subjects is only an inquiry proposal.

tido-hemvisttid-atta-ar-medborgarskap::s.label: partial
tido-hemvisttid-atta-ar-medborgarskap::s.reason: The judge (low confidence) wrote that the eight-year rule is not visible, but the proposition (HD03175) does mention eight years; the truncated law text only fails to show it, so the note must not claim the rule is absent. Kept partial because the law text itself does not confirm it.
tido-hemvisttid-atta-ar-medborgarskap::s.missing_sv: Det synliga lagtextutdraget visar inte om åttaårsgränsen för hemvisttid ingår i lagen, så hur stor del av löftet lagen täcker är obekräftat.

tido-aterfall-straffas-hardare::sfs-2026.label: none
tido-aterfall-straffas-hardare::sfs-2026.reason: Only raises the minimum penalty for gross tax crime in a general penalty-scale increase; its own note finds nothing about recidivism.

tido-aterfall-straffas-hardare::sfs-2026.label: none
tido-aterfall-straffas-hardare::sfs-2026.reason: Only raises the minimum penalty for gross benefit fraud in a general penalty increase; its own note finds nothing about recidivism.

tido-oversyn-brottsskadeersattning-skade.label: none
tido-oversyn-brottsskadeersattning-skade.reason: Only lifts the garnishment ban for traffic-injury compensation when the claim is damages for crime; its own note says the core of the promise is in other laws.
